name: Fec
aliases: Fec, of the line of Abek
description: Fec is a limping orc hunter, born in the Kolaghan clan and of the line of Abek, who serves in Yasova Dragonclaw's hunting party.

timeline.summary: An Ojutai broodling appears and its aven interpreter sentences Tae Jin to die by ice for sacrilege.
timeline.quote: Tae Jin, by the command of the Great Teacher, you are accused of the crime of sacrilege and sentenced to die by ice.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova decides to go on to Ugin's grave, accepting the portent of Tae Jin's arrival and the windfolk's vision.
timeline.quote: We will go on to Ugin's grave.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Naiva kills the broodling by driving her spear through its eye.
timeline.quote: Naiva thrust the obsidian point of her spear into the dragon's unblinking eye

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Fec warns of an approaching dragon tempest, and the party shelters in a rock chamber.
timeline.quote: It's a dragon tempest, and it's moving in fast,

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: A dragon tempest breaks and Mattak asks Yasova to come see something.
timeline.quote: First Mother, you'd best come see.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Naiva walks point with Fec and learns he was cast out by the Kolaghan for his limp, and they argue about the old ways.
timeline.quote: In the Kolaghan clan those who cannot keep up are left behind.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Receiving no answer, Yasova sends Fec ahead to the cave and orders others to guard Tae Jin against possible Ojutai trickery.
timeline.quote: It might be. I want you to guard Tae Jin from attack by any of his Ojutai brethren

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: From a hidden cleft the group watches Fec speak with a pregnant woman who resembles Mevra and claims an illness killed the camp.
timeline.quote: An illness ate away their lives and brought them death. I am all that is left.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: The rest of the party arrives; Tae Jin tells Naiva he would never mistake her for her sister again.
timeline.quote: I wouldn't mistake you for your sister ever again.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova tells the girls they must safeguard memory and asks Tae Jin to stay to recite Ugin's story to Fec for carving.
timeline.quote: I would like you to recite Ugin's story once again to Fec so it can be carved and preserved in more than one place.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Fec warns the group of an approaching dragon and advises cover, then tries to distract and attack it with his weapons.
timeline.quote: he warned the group of an approaching dragon and advised them to take cover
